note: Every spoken line, as the game's code says it (who + text, matched exactly), with the delivery sent to ElevenLabs (say: audio tags in brackets) where it differs. CREW lines are said by whichever of DOM or BRIAN the player isn't or is, so they're recorded for both. Police lines are Portuguese radio chatter (no subtitles).

lines.text: Reyes keeps a hundred million dollars in an evidence vault inside police headquarters.
And every cop guarding it is on his payroll.
Floor it! Pull that vault out of there!
lines.say: [urgently] Floor it! Pull that vault out of there!

lines.text: It’s out! Every cop in Rio is coming. Follow my route, or find your own. I’ll guide you.
lines.say: [excited] It’s out! Every cop in Rio is coming. Follow my route, or find your own. I’ll guide you.

lines.text: Bikes! Two of them, coming up either side of you. They can’t take a hit. Give them the vault.
lines.say: [urgently] Bikes! Two of them, coming up either side of you. They can’t take a hit. Give them the vault.

lines.text: Bus! It’s pulling across right in front of you! Go round its tail!
lines.say: [urgently] Bus! It’s pulling across right in front of you! Go round its tail!

lines.text: You hurt him! He’s still coming. Again!
lines.say: [excited] You hurt him! He’s still coming. Again!

lines.text: He’s smoking! One more swing!
lines.say: [excited] He’s smoking! One more swing!

lines.text: Okay, new route.
That works too. Rerouting.
Not my way, but fine. Rerouting.
lines.say: [sarcastic] Not my way, but fine. Rerouting.

lines.text: Change of plan. Recalculating.
Straight on to the bridge.
Stay on this street for now.
Hang a left at the next corner!
Go right at the next corner!
Bridge ahead. Drag that decoy across, and make it look good.
Bridge ahead. Get to the yellow gantry at the far end.
Next intersection, hang a left!
Next intersection, go right!
Roadblock dead ahead! Don’t stop, smash right through it!
lines.say: [urgently] Roadblock dead ahead! Don’t stop, smash right through it!

lines.text: Spike strip ahead! Gap's on the left!
lines.say: [urgently] Spike strip ahead! Gap's on the left!

lines.text: Spike strip ahead! Gap's on the right!
lines.say: [urgently] Spike strip ahead! Gap's on the right!

lines.text: You lost a tire! Hold it together!
lines.say: [nervous] You lost a tire! Hold it together!

lines.text: There’s a bank on the corner where we turn. Swing that vault right through it!
Reyes is on the bridge! Two black SUVs coming through the cops, and they’re armed!
lines.say: [urgently] Reyes is on the bridge! Two black SUVs coming through the cops, and they’re armed!

lines.text: They’re stopping… lining up across the bridge. They think you’re done.
lines.say: [cautiously] They’re stopping… lining up across the bridge. They think you’re done.

lines.text: It’s moving! And here they come, head-on! Swing that thing!
lines.say: [excited] It’s moving! And here they come, head-on! Swing that thing!

lines.text: Barbosa overpass coming up. Gisele’s parked under it with the truck, ramp down. Line the vault up with her ramp!
Swap’s done. The real one’s sitting in a garbage truck under the overpass. Now make them chase the fake!
lines.say: [excited] Swap’s done. The real one’s sitting in a garbage truck under the overpass. Now make them chase the fake!

lines.text: Friendlies coming up behind you: two “police” cars. That’s Roman and Han. Don’t hit them.
Talk to me! Are you okay?
lines.say: [nervous] Talk to me! Are you okay?

lines.text: Go. Get out of there.
Of course it is.
lines.say: [sighs] Of course it is.

lines.text: That’s far enough. Leave it for them. It’s empty anyway.
You made it. Kill the engines.
lines.say: [warmly] You made it. Kill the engines.

lines.text: Then hold on tight.
Hooked. Let’s ride.
Go, go, go!
lines.say: [shouting] Go, go, go!

lines.text: Backing in. Get the cables on it!
lines.say: [shouting] Backing in. Get the cables on it!

lines.text: Did we just drive a vault through a bank?
lines.say: [laughs] Did we just drive a vault through a bank?

lines.text: We’ll never shake them dragging this. Not both of us.
You don’t. You keep going.
Get clear. I’ll handle them.
Not yet.
Now let’s give them a show.
Still breathing. The car’s not.
lines.say: [tired] Still breathing. The car’s not.

lines.text: Then bring a bigger truck.
Look behind us. That’s every cop in the city on this bridge.
So what, we stop?
Hey! What did you just do?
lines.say: [shouting] Hey! What did you just do?

lines.text: You’re out of your mind!
lines.say: [shouting] You’re out of your mind!

lines.text: Miss me?
For the record, this is the dumbest plan I have ever signed up for.
Let them shoot.
Reyes is mine. He’s not walking away from this one.
You two, start driving. Sunrise tomorrow, I’m coming after you myself.
It’s empty.
Well. Would you look at that.
They are shooting at us!
lines.say: [shouting] They are shooting at us!

lines.text: Vault is exposed. Go, go!
lines.say: [shouting] Vault is exposed. Go, go!

lines.text: Covering you! Go!
lines.say: [shouting] Covering you! Go!

lines.text: That’s our exit. See you under the Barbosa overpass.
Hooked!
Not one of them looked twice.
Pardon me.
That one’s on the city.
Two for two.
Officer Roman, reporting for duty! Who wants a ticket?
Go, go, go!
lines.say: [shouting] Go, go, go!

lines.text: Ten tons of garbage, and every bit of it ours.
Ha! Write me a ticket!
lines.say: [laughs] Ha! Write me a ticket!

lines.text: Sorry, officer! My foot slipped!
Did you see that? Did everybody see that?
lines.say: [excited] Did you see that? Did everybody see that?

lines.text: Pins out!
lines.say: [shouting] Pins out!

lines.text: Evening, officers!
Last lock. Everybody stand back.
Told you I could open it.
I see you. Bring it straight up my ramp, and don’t you brake till I say.
Steady… steady… now!
lines.say: Steady… steady… [shouting] now!

lines.text: It’s in. Shutting it.
Central para todas as viaturas: roubaram o cofre da sede. Dois carros estão rebocando o cofre pela avenida.
Atenção, todas as unidades: o helicóptero tem contato visual. Mantenham a perseguição.
Bloqueio montado à frente. Empurrem eles para o bloqueio!
Atenção, viaturas: fechem todos os acessos à ponte!
Eles estão na ponte! Todas as viaturas para a ponte, agora!
Unidade doze em perseguição. Eles estão arrastando o cofre pela pista!
Central, temos várias viaturas destruídas. Precisamos de reforço, urgente!
Eles estão usando o cofre como arma! Mantenham distância!
Central, perdemos o cofre debaixo do viaduto! Alguém tem visual?
Achei! O cofre está saindo do viaduto, sentido ponte!
